name: Fuobe old phone

dataset.what: Photos taken on real 2005-2012 camera phones Fuobe owns, or licensed with AI-training rights.
captions: Every caption starts with "fboldphone style, " and goes on in one or two long sentences (Z-Image style): who or what is in the picture, where, the light and the framing.
Describe the scene, never the look the LoRA learns (no "grainy", "film look" or the like), so the trigger carries it.
No names of people, places that identify someone, brands, camera models or photographers.

notes: A second option for the iPhone and DigitalCam looks once it is trained.
